text:
Maya: quick heads-up — q3 webinar landing conversion dropped ~18% MoM, dashboard flagged it this morning :eyes:
Sam: ugh. which dashboard? link?
Maya: https://dash.redwood.ai/marketing/webinars?panel=landing_conv — spikes in sessions but not in conversions
Ibrahim: tagging issue maybe? saw a bunch of ambiguous utm_source values in GA yesterday (noreply, unknown)
Lina: we shipped a tiny CTA copy test last week that updated the href. could've stripped query params by accident. i pushed a revert to prod at 09:12 if that helps
Olivia: can someone paste the raw landing URLs from the last 48h? want to check UTM intactness
Sam: pulling now. SQL I ran: ```SELECT page_url, utm_source, COUNT(*) as sessions FROM events WHERE event_date >= '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 20;```
Sam: results show top page_url with utm_source = "(not set)" for 22% of visits, compared to 3% baseline last month
Maya: that aligns — conversions are concentrated in visits with utm_source=linkedin and email; the anonymous visits have near-zero conversion
Ibrahim: likely the CTA redirect overwritten ? can we repro locally by hitting the post-click link with sample params?
Lina: repro steps: 1) open campaign CTA in staging 2) click 3) watch the network tab. i can run now.
Lina: confirmed — a tiny nginx config i'd added to normalize trailing slashes was stripping query strings on a 302. absolute facepalm. :sweat_smile:
Olivia: nice catch. can we hotfix? rolling back the nginx change should restore query params
Sam: rollback deployed at 10:04 — traffic shows query params returning, reindexing is in progress
ProductBot: [deploy] rollback/nginx-strip-qs performed by Lina — status: success — 10:04:12
Maya: awesome. can ops also force a re-ingest of the last 6 hours so dashboards reflect corrected utm counts?
Ibrahim: on it — kicking off backfill job now. ETA ~18 minutes.
Sam: once backfill done, let's rerun cohort attribution with a 7-day lookback and compare conversion rate before/after fix.
Olivia: assigning follow-ups: Ibrahim to backfill & confirm, Lina to add unit test for nginx config and open PR, Sam to rerun attribution, Maya to update comms to PLG & sales if numbers recover. target: update in 1h.
Maya: thanks everyone. also adding a note to the runbook: never normalize redirects without preserving querystring.
Lina: PR opened -> https://git.internal/redwood/nginx-config/pull/482 — includes tests and a short blurb about UTMs
Ibrahim: backfill finished at 10:23 — dashboards recalculated. landing conv is back up +16% vs last 24h baseline (not full recovery to previous month but trending up)
Sam: running attribution compare now. quick summary: before fix (last 24h) conv 2.1%, after fix (next 2h) conv 3.9% — big delta. putting numbers in the weekly KPI doc
Maya: adding a blurb to the weekly KPI thread: root cause = nginx querystring strip; impact = ~18% short-term conv drop; mitigation = rollback + tests; follow-up = alert rule for sudden utm attr anomalies
Olivia: can we add an automated check to the dashboard to surface >5% increase in (not set) utm_source in 1h windows?
Sam: yep — will add a detector and a Slack alert to #marketing for that metric.
Maya: closing loop: thank you. will post an update to sales + PLG and include the timeline and numbers. :thumbsup:
